print(f"  q[1]: {qc.qubits[1]}")

print("\nCircuit instructions:")
for instruction in qc.data:
    qbit = instruction.qubits[0]
    print(f"  Instruction: {instruction.operation.name} on qubit: {qbit}")

print("\nOur fixed script output:")
for instruction in cqc.data:

    register = qbit._register
    index = None
    for i, q in enumerate(register):
        if q == qbit:
            index = i
            break
    print(f"  Register: {register}, Index: {index}")
